rows.grounds: inclusive particle; sandhi form of api
divine identity predicated of subject; sandhi form of viṣṇuḥ

items.question: What divine identity is attained by bearing the object on the neck or the right arm?
premises: The object may be borne on the neck or on the right arm.
A person who bears it in either place is identified as Viṣṇu.
This identification is asserted to be beyond doubt.
items.inference: Bearing the object on the neck or the right arm confers the status of Viṣṇu without doubt.
uncertainties: The specific object borne is not named in this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: Whether worn on the neck or on the right arm, that person too is Viṣṇu—there is no doubt.
